instances.query:
I am playing with a set of remeounds where I need to arrange the remeounds into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a remeound
Unstack a remeound from on top of another remeound
Put down a remeound
Stack a remeound on top of another remeound

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one remeound at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a remeound if my hand is empty.
I can only pick up a remeound if the remeound is on the table and the remeound is clear. A remeound is clear if the remeound has no other remeounds on top of it and if the remeound is not picked up.
I can only unstack a remeound from on top of another remeound if the remeound I am unstacking was really on top of the other remeound.
I can only unstack a remeound from on top of another remeound if the remeound I am unstacking is clear.
Once I pick up or unstack a remeound, I am holding the remeound.
I can only put down a remeound that I am holding.
I can only stack a remeound on top of another remeound if I am holding the remeound being stacked.
I can only stack a remeound on top of another remeound if the remeound onto which I am stacking the remeound is clear.
Once I put down or stack a remeound, my hand becomes empty.
Once you stack a remeound on top of a second remeound, the second remeound is no longer clear.

My goal is to have that the commodety remeound is on top of the bruthful remeound.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

(put-down b2)

(put-down b3)
(unstack b4 b1)
(put-down b4)
(pick-up b2)
(stack b2 b1)
